visual_grammar.medium_handling: Episode-specific modernist book plate built from the deck's shared letterpress/lithographic/etched/newsprint vocabulary. Technique may change dramatically with the episode—headlines, notation, parody, catechism, stream of consciousness—but remains visibly printed on the same material book-world.
visual_grammar.composition: Treat each trump as an illustrated episode cover or plate whose formal organization follows that episode's literary method: austere Stephen plates, embodied Bloom realism, journalistic fragmentation in Aeolus, musical recurrence in Sirens, gigantism/parody in Cyclops, historical style-bands in Oxen, expressionist hallucination in Circe, diagrammatic catechism in Ithaca, flowing text-body in Penelope, and authorial/map/page structures at the end.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Etched and lithographic line can sharpen, smear, overprint, fragment, dissolve, enlarge, or turn typographic as the episode demands; every transformation should still reveal ink, plate, type, paper, or hand rather than digital effect.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Dublin greys/browns/greens and wine-dark blue carry the common world, while each episode redistributes contrast—from Stephen's severe black-white distance through Bloom's warm mids to Nighttown red-black and Penelope's soft flowing dark—without losing print coherence.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Historically grounded 1904 human and city scale when the episode is realistic; perspective may become map-like, gigantic, hallucinatory, diagrammatic, or authorial only when the episode's formal method earns it.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Joycean specificity matters: episode locations, bodies, food, signs, objects, clothing, print fragments, and small Dublin material facts should carry as much weight as mythic correspondence. Experimental devices organize those particulars rather than replace them.
visual_grammar.finish: One impossible illustrated edition whose printing method changes with Joyce's prose style while the paper/book remains continuous. Literary experiment should be visible as material form, not a generic surrealist overlay.
avoid: decorative typography unrelated to the episode's formal method
sanitizing bodily or mundane detail into tasteful symbolism

factorization.gloss: Zero — Forger is the precondition before Ulysses's day: Stephen's self-declared refusal and the uncreated conscience he intends to make. The book's Dublin has not yet begun its count, but the forge is already hot.
factorization.visual_logic: Leave Stephen at an edge—sea, pier, page, city—inside more unclaimed space than established system. The composition should feel like a page waiting to be written while one figure prepares to author himself.

factorization.gloss: One — Telemachus is the first operative consciousness of the day: Stephen alone as the unit through which tower, mockery, grief, and inheritance are initially measured.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one vertical/descending Stephen-axis through the tower scene. Other figures may intrude, but the formal count begins from one consciousness organizing what hurts around him.

factorization.gloss: Two — Nestor makes the relation to inherited authority irreducible: young and old, student and master, present and history, Stephen and Deasy. The dyad cannot be reconciled into a neutral middle.
factorization.visual_logic: Build an unmistakable young/old or learner/authority dyad across desk, payment, lesson, or historical text. The charged relation is the episode's indivisible atom.

factorization.gloss: Three — Proteus is irreducible mutable perception: perceiver, perceived world, and language/thought mediating between them. Its instability is a new three-term ontology, not a composite of prior social roles.
factorization.visual_logic: Use a triadic field of Stephen, strand/sea, and mutable sign or perceptual layer. Horizon, words, and body should refuse to collapse into a simple subject/object pair.

factorization.gloss: Two squared — Nestor's inherited relation stabilizes into Calypso's domestic web: Bloom, Molly, home, and routine make relation into a four-corner lived structure. Authority becomes household rather than doctrine.
factorization.visual_logic: Square the relational dyad into a stable domestic frame—kitchen/bed/cat/couple or other paired relations crossing—so ordinary household structure visibly arises from repeated relation rather than abstract geometry.

factorization.gloss: Five — Lotus Eaters is irreducible drift and appetite: desire diffuses through letter, soap, church, street, scent, and fantasy without settling into a simpler purpose. The episode's indirection simply is.
factorization.visual_logic: Give the image one drifting sensory current that refuses firm center or destination. Overlap/desire should feel atomic as a mode of consciousness rather than assembled plot.

factorization.gloss: Two times three — Nestor's inheritance/authority relation meets Proteus's mutable perception in Hades: ancestry, fatherhood, death, and the cemetery are processed through Bloom's wandering sensorium until history becomes mortality felt in the body.
factorization.visual_logic: Cross a relational procession—living/dead, father/son, mourner/corpse—with a triadic perceptual structure of observer, graveyard, and associative thought. The funeral must feel both social and internally protean.

factorization.gloss: Seven — Aeolus makes rhetoric an irreducible force: language blows, headlines strike, speakers inflate, and public discourse moves matter before meaning can settle. It is a new atomic register of the day.
factorization.visual_logic: Organize around one forceful current of headlines/type/speech that cuts through the office. Fragmentation may be many pieces, but they should all belong to one indivisible rhetorical wind.

factorization.gloss: Two cubed — Nestor's relation recursively multiplied becomes Lestrygonians' social food-chain: eater/eaten, buyer/seller, helper/helped, body/city. Relation at several scales becomes appetite as system.
factorization.visual_logic: Nest paired relations at multiple scales—mouth/food, Bloom/crowd, eater/eaten, helper/blind boy—so the city reads as a recursive web of exchange and consumption rather than one lunch scene.

factorization.gloss: Three squared — Proteus's mutable perception turns back on itself in Scylla and Charybdis: Stephen builds a theory of Hamlet from mirrors of artist, father, son, text, and self. Interpretation becomes perception examining its own machinery.
factorization.visual_logic: Nest one triadic interpretive relation inside another: Stephen/text/audience echoed by son/father/author or another threefold reflection. The theory should visibly become a structure made of recursive perspective.

factorization.gloss: Two times five — Nestor's relational city meets Lotus Eaters' drifting desire in Wandering Rocks: Dublin becomes a network of simultaneous encounters, errands, appetites, and substitutions moving past one another.
factorization.visual_logic: Let a mapped social grid carry many wandering currents. Paired crossings/encounters should be threaded by drifting routes, so city structure and desire-driven circulation remain simultaneously legible.

factorization.gloss: Eleven — Sirens is irreducible music: rhythmic recurrence, seduction, sound before explanation. The episode cannot be reduced to plot because its atomic event is hearing itself.
factorization.visual_logic: Make musical/rhythmic structure the singular organizing law of the entire plate—notation, repeated gesture, visual refrain, or sound-wave interval—rather than decorative notes added to a bar scene.

factorization.gloss: Four times three — Calypso's stable local frame meets Proteus's mutating register in Cyclops: the pub's bounded community is repeatedly inflated by stylistic parody until belonging hardens into gigantic one-eyed identity.
factorization.visual_logic: Hold a four-square pub/social enclosure while a three-part or mutating narrative layer repeatedly enlarges/distorts it. Realism and gigantic parody must coexist, making rigidity visible through stylistic mutation.

factorization.gloss: Thirteen — Nausicaa is an irreducible gaze/fantasy event: looking and being looked at form a charged fiction that cannot be made innocent by decomposing it into setting, romance, or desire.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one uncompromising gaze-axis across the divided beach scene. Romantic surface and bodily fact can differ, but all formal tension should answer to the singular act of looking.

factorization.gloss: Two times seven — inherited relation/history from Nestor meets Aeolus's public language in Oxen of the Sun: generation is narrated through the historical succession of English styles while childbirth makes inheritance literal.
factorization.visual_logic: Let one relational/generative event persist while the rhetoric/print register changes in ordered bands or stages. History of language should act on the same human birth rather than become separate decorative samples.

factorization.gloss: Three times five — Proteus's mutable perception meets Lotus Eaters' desire-drift in Circe: sensation, fantasy, guilt, appetite, and identity become fully hallucinatory, every object capable of becoming another.
factorization.visual_logic: Combine a triadic perceptual scaffold with one drifting/desiring current, then allow both to mutate visibly across transformations. The chaos should have recursive psychic logic rather than arbitrary surreal clutter.

factorization.gloss: Two to the fourth — relation recursively repeated reaches exhausted saturation in Eumaeus: Bloom/Stephen, host/guest, teller/listener, fact/lie repeat until companionship survives mostly as patient habit after Nighttown.
factorization.visual_logic: Use nested paired seating, cups, stories, glances, or shelter frames until the dyadic structure feels overused, tired, and nevertheless sustaining. Repetition should create exhaustion rather than catastrophe.

factorization.gloss: Seventeen — Ithaca is irreducible analytic clarity: catechism turns the ordinary into a precise cosmos whose exactness cannot be simplified without losing its strange tenderness.
factorization.visual_logic: Let one rigorous diagrammatic/question-answer order govern the plate from streets to cocoa to stars. The formal system should be singular and lucid, not an accumulation of unrelated infographics.

factorization.gloss: Two times nine — relation enters Scylla's perception-squared and becomes Penelope: Molly's network of Bloom, Boylan, Gibraltar, daughter, body, memory, and yes is recursive inner language held by intimate relation.
factorization.visual_logic: Place a relational dyad or intimate bodily ground inside nested streams/loops of memory and perception. The interior monologue should fold back repeatedly without losing the body/bed relation anchoring it.

factorization.gloss: Nineteen — Trieste-Zurich-Paris is irreducible authorship-in-exile: the work exists because writing persists across displacement. The three cities are biography, but the atomic act is Joyce continuing to compose.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one continuous writing/authorial line crossing the three mapped cities and aging vignettes. Geography may be multiple, but the act of composition must read as one indivisible persistence.

factorization.gloss: Four times five — Calypso's lived domestic cycle meets Lotus Eaters' drift and dissolves into Riverrun: stable recurrence becomes fluid linguistic return, the household/day/book loosening back into the river that can begin again.
factorization.visual_logic: Start from a recognizable cyclical/frame structure and let one drifting current liquefy its boundaries into text-water-return. The old enclosure should visibly survive as ancestry inside the new river, not vanish without trace.
